changed.what: Crate rule rewritten (DESIGN): test targets, example targets and a closed list of declared operator binaries (autobins off, no default-run, none named frob-conformance, record_gate the only gates.toml writer); gauntlet-mutations enables every crate's `conformance` feature and never an nc-* one; the command lint now refuses five wrong forms (frob conformance, frob-conformance as a command, default-binary cargo run, --test g0..g5, undeclared targets); new binaries_declared check; seed form MR-Cnn for N38a-15's carried relations; last_seen written by the recorder; e2e plant wrong-command-forms.

First-round table brought to the beads (Marrow 128; Kinesis eight rows with two merges; Spark raisers; Cortex eight; Arena 21; Surface row added); status held and reason field; retired list filled (730->840, 882->582; 296 printed, 294 in use; withdrawn proposals); rule 5: a run-proposed number is never offered to another request; rule 7: admitted interim forms; new rule 8: no 8xx before N35x-01's hold; tests added.

Twelve uncoded refusals added (three Skeleton, two scene, two control, four mission-query, machine-not-local in 6xx by DESIGN): 61 = 39 assigned + 1 merged + 21 held, sixteen chapters, new title; hold 324/325/327; 323, 326, 901-907 retired as withdrawn proposals; resource-read-over-cap has no interim; interim column explained; rows this round does not file listed; acceptance and tests updated.
Receipt gains `reduced {count, target}` on entries and `reduced` on gate lines, which N38b-25 writes and N38b-19 reads; test reduced_count_marked.

Pilot id grammar (pilot-id-form); tier S with required_by (§27.17); per-mechanism funding with gated_beads, Partial package status and fundable_bead; frozen protocol.sampling_episodes_per_design read by control.mpc via sampling_allowance; fallback.also for conditional upper-tier fallbacks; command form `--example pilots`; reasons in N38-REF (dep added); tests and e2e step.

FACT rows get a computed obligation: rerun from derivation front matter (pilot record via the register, or reread with receipt) instead of the requested row fields (corrected form, matches N09-KA); dep N38a-09 (no cycle).

Rule 5 exempts a numbered row's own `slug` field (N33-CX, N25-CX keep slugs), with test; vague request paragraph replaced by the requests on file (ka: 17 owners, 145 plus the sensor rows; cx: 20 owners, 187), noting the sill-mount band is N25-KA's late-03.

`killed` is never written by the recorder: derived by N40-03's apply_decisions from a fired kill decision with docs/adr/ADR-<gate-name>-<milestone>.md; record_gate stated as the one writer, with a mode-word dispatch for N29bp1-01's reaffirm; tests killed_is_derived_not_written and mode_word_dispatch replace killed_needs_fallback.
